system.description:
Target: A Creature with the @Trait[berserker] Trait.

Effect: You've trained your Pokemon as a @Trait[berserker]. As a complex action costing 2PP, you may target one member of your Team (or another ally, if combined with @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e.core-perks.13JRGGWEpyfuZZuG]{Tactician}) and they gain the @Affliction[enraged] Affliction for 2 activations, as though the creature had used the Rage move. If used during a League Combat Rules scenario, this may be used as a @Trait[command] Action in the same way as Styles are.
